name: Samoto Shizue
source:
Shizue Sasamoto is Hiroko's older sister and Miki's aunt. After Hiroko and Miki, she falls victim to the protagonist's clutches. She has a voluptuous figure that is even more voluptuous than Hiroko.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071023044146/http://www.bpb.jp/products/r2/index.html]the official site[/url]]
